en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a river scene on the Elbe at Mühlberg. In the foreground a long paddle steamer is moored or moving along the river, with smoke coming from its funnel and people visible on deck. On the opposite bank stand a cluster of buildings surrounded by trees, including a prominent manor‑ or castle‑like structure on a slight rise. The printed caption at the top in German identifies the location and mentions the harbor scene with the castle.
